contentNote: Concise editorial summaries based on MSigDB collection documentation; not verbatim descriptions.

H.title: Hallmark gene sets
H.description: Broad biological programs with coordinated expression.
H.details: Combines overlapping signatures to reduce redundancy.

C1.title: Positional gene sets
C1.details: Useful for exploring regional genomic effects.

C2.title: Curated gene sets
C2.details: Includes expert curation and published studies.

C2:CGP.title: Chemical and genetic perturbations
C2:CGP.details: UP and DN signatures describe opposite responses.

C2:CP.title: Canonical pathways
C2:CP.details: Expert knowledge organizes genes into cellular processes.

C2:CP:BIOCARTA.title: BioCarta pathways
C2:CP:BIOCARTA.details: A historical resource for signaling pathways.

C2:CP:KEGG_LEGACY.title: KEGG legacy pathways
C2:CP:KEGG_LEGACY.details: Retained separately from newer KEGG MEDICUS sets.

C2:CP:KEGG_MEDICUS.title: KEGG MEDICUS pathways
C2:CP:KEGG_MEDICUS.details: A newer KEGG resource within MSigDB.

C2:CP:PID.title: Pathway Interaction Database
C2:CP:PID.description: Pathways from the NCI PID resource.
C2:CP:PID.details: Captures curated molecular interactions and signaling.

C2:CP:REACTOME.title: Reactome pathways
C2:CP:REACTOME.details: MSigDB filters highly redundant pathway sets.

C2:CP:WIKIPATHWAYS.title: WikiPathways
C2:CP:WIKIPATHWAYS.details: A community-supported source of pathway knowledge.

C3.title: Regulatory target gene sets
C3.details: Includes microRNA and transcription factor targets.

C3:MIR.title: MicroRNA targets
C3:MIR.details: Combines miRDB predictions and legacy motif sets.

C3:MIR:MIRDB.title: miRDB targets
C3:MIR:MIRDB.details: Derived from the miRDB prediction resource.

C3:MIR:MIR_LEGACY.title: Legacy microRNA targets
C3:MIR:MIR_LEGACY.details: Genes share candidate sites in untranslated regions.

C3:TFT.title: Transcription factor targets
C3:TFT.details: Includes GTRD predictions and older motif sets.

C3:TFT:GTRD.title: GTRD targets
C3:TFT:GTRD.details: Groups genes using promoter-region binding predictions.

C3:TFT:TFT_LEGACY.title: Legacy transcription factor targets
C3:TFT:TFT_LEGACY.details: Shared upstream motifs suggest potential regulatory targets.

C4.title: Computational gene sets
C4.description: Patterns mined from cancer expression data.
C4.details: Includes cancer metaprograms, neighborhoods, and modules.

C4:3CA.title: Curated Cancer Cell Atlas
C4:3CA.details: Captures shared and lineage-specific cellular patterns.

C4:CGN.title: Cancer gene neighborhoods
C4:CGN.details: Neighborhoods come from multiple expression datasets.

C4:CM.title: Cancer modules
C4:CM.details: Groups genes with cancer-associated activity patterns.

C5.title: Ontology gene sets
C5.details: Includes Gene Ontology and human phenotype associations.

C5:GO.title: Gene Ontology
C5:GO.description: Gene groups defined by GO annotations.
C5:GO.details: Covers processes, cellular locations, and molecular activities.

C5:GO:BP.title: Biological Process
C5:GO:BP.details: Describes coordinated biological events and programs.

C5:GO:MF.title: Molecular Function
C5:GO:MF.details: Describes activities such as binding and catalysis.

C5:HPO.title: Human Phenotype Ontology
C5:HPO.details: Connects genetic associations with disease-related abnormalities.

C6.title: Oncogenic signatures
C6.description: Expression signatures associated with cancer pathways.
C6.details: Many originate from perturbing known cancer genes.

C7.title: Immunologic signatures
C7.details: Includes immune perturbations and vaccination studies.

C7:IMMUNESIGDB.title: ImmuneSigDB
C7:IMMUNESIGDB.details: Includes published human and mouse immune studies.

C7:VAX.title: Vaccine response signatures
C7:VAX.details: Curated by the Human Immunology Project Consortium.

C8.title: Cell type signatures
C8.details: Helps interpret cell identities in human tissues.

C9.title: Computational perturbation signatures
C9.description: Expression patterns associated with gene dependencies.
C9.details: Derived using DepMap CRISPR and CCLE expression data.

MH.title: Mouse-ortholog hallmarks
MH.description: Human hallmark programs mapped to mouse.
MH.details: Allows hallmark analysis with mouse gene identifiers.

M1.title: Positional gene sets
M1.description: Mouse genes grouped by chromosome band.
M1.details: Useful for exploring regional genomic effects.

M2.title: Curated gene sets
M2.details: Includes literature curation and pathway resources.

M2:CGP.title: Chemical and genetic perturbations
M2:CGP.details: Captures experimentally observed increases and decreases.

M2:CP.title: Canonical pathways
M2:CP.details: Expert knowledge organizes genes into cellular processes.

M2:CP:BIOCARTA.title: BioCarta pathways
M2:CP:BIOCARTA.details: A historical resource for signaling pathways.

M2:CP:REACTOME.title: Reactome pathways
M2:CP:REACTOME.details: MSigDB filters highly redundant pathway sets.

M2:CP:WIKIPATHWAYS.title: WikiPathways
M2:CP:WIKIPATHWAYS.details: A community-supported source of pathway knowledge.

M3.title: Regulatory target gene sets
M3.details: Includes microRNA and transcription factor predictions.

M3:GTRD.title: GTRD targets
M3:GTRD.details: Groups genes using promoter-region binding predictions.

M5.title: Ontology gene sets
M5.details: Includes GO and tumor-related phenotype terms.

M5:GO.title: Gene Ontology
M5:GO.description: Gene groups defined by GO annotations.
M5:GO.details: Covers processes, cellular locations, and molecular activities.

M5:GO:BP.title: Biological Process
M5:GO:BP.details: Describes coordinated biological events and programs.

M5:GO:MF.title: Molecular Function
M5:GO:MF.details: Describes activities such as binding and catalysis.

M5:MPT.title: Tumor phenotype ontology
M5:MPT.details: Uses cancer-related Mammalian Phenotype Ontology terms.

M7.title: Immunologic signatures
M7.details: Provides signatures for interpreting immune-related expression.

M8.title: Cell type signatures
M8.details: Supports interpretation of mouse tissue cell identities.
